Euro Hits 17-Month Low Amid French Debt and Spanish Turmoil

The euro has fallen to its lowest point in 17 months against the US dollar. This decline is attributed to concerns over French debt and turmoil in Spain. The currency's drop was noted by multiple news outlets, highlighting the economic pressures affecting the Eurozone.
